author: Michael Oggwu <198796435+mgkvibez@users.noreply.github.com>
tooling: hand-written, reviewed against the published advisory

statements.impact_statement: The advisory is excessive CPU consumption in dns.name.from_wire_parser(), reached only by code that parses DNS wire-format names out of a response. AutoPWN Suite never imports dns, never resolves names with it and never parses a DNS message body: name resolution goes through the operating system, and the only network client is requests. The package arrives as a transitive dependency of email-validator, which is itself an optional 'email' extra of pydantic that this project never requests and never calls, so the vulnerable function is present on disk but unreachable from any code path this product runs.
statements.status_notes: Reviewed 2026-11-09 for AutoPWN Suite 2.9.0 by reading the advisory (GHSA-45c3-73f7-pv4m, fixed in dnspython 2.9.0) and tracing the dependency: sigstore -> pydantic -> email-validator (extra: email) -> dnspython. A grep of autopwn_suite/, api.py, autopwn.py and scripts/ finds no import of dns, email_validator or EmailStr, and no pydantic import outside the sigstore call path, so nothing in this product can call dns.name.from_wire_parser(). The fix cannot be taken yet because every dnspython release that contains it requires Python >=3.11 and this project supports 3.10; the declaration must be reassessed when that floor moves or when anything in this project starts validating email addresses. Independent human review is required before merge, which is why this document is in a pull request rather than merged directly.
